artifact: P2 v2 Owner-local preflight contracts and evaluator lineage

overall.one_line_summary: P2 v2 cannot reach passed_pending_owner because evaluator compatibility is unproved, active preflight resolves v1 controls, and the shared artifact registry rejects the measured-request schema.
strengths: The active v2 profile, envelope, campaign revision, base candidates, adaptive policy, and proposer contract are committed before the first measured run.
The repository remains clean and all real lifecycle counters remain zero.
The evaluator diff is limited to optional progress instrumentation and has no observed scientific-output difference in four deterministic differential cases.
weaknesses: No canonical compatibility manifest currently permits the evaluator byte drift.
The preflight implementation hard-codes the historical v1 profile and protocol campaign binding.
The shared registry cannot validate myis.p2-measured-request.v1 and the v1 receipt omits required v2 request/tree/compatibility bindings.

exact_behavioral_difference: evaluate_baseline accepts an optional progress_sink callable.
The callable is invoked once for each query, including queries without positive relevance.
A raising progress sink aborts evaluation before an authoritative result is returned.
Scoring, family ranking, lexical tie-breaking, metrics, protected rows, and scientific commitments are unchanged.

strengths: The audit traces code, controls, receipts, schemas, tests, and report policy.
weaknesses: The local test extra was initially unavailable and independent verification has not yet closed the repair.
suggestions: Run the compatibility verifier and the exact v2 preflight regression from a clean committed checkout.

strengths: Each blocker has an exact failing condition and negative-test target.
weaknesses: The current preflight cannot express evaluator compatibility failure separately.
suggestions: Add an exact evaluator_compatibility check and v2 receipt binding.

weaknesses: No passed preflight may be claimed on the reviewed commit.
suggestions: Keep synthetic preflight proof distinct from a real Owner-local receipt.

strengths: Source-of-truth already identifies the active v2 controls.
weaknesses: Runtime preflight and read-model code can still select v1.
suggestions: Use one fail-closed active-source resolver in every consumer.

strengths: The evaluator was compared by source diff, AST normalization, and differential cases.
weaknesses: The proof is not yet a versioned canonical contract.
suggestions: Bind the proof rather than aliasing the old evaluator hash.

strengths: The v2 measured request already binds commit, tree, controls, and zero counters.
weaknesses: The shared validator and receipt contract do not carry those bindings end to end.
suggestions: Register the request through lazy dispatch and issue a versioned v2 receipt.

findings.evidence_locator: The current evaluator hash is compared directly with lineage_hashes.evaluator_sha256 in the accepted P1 receipt.
findings.observation: P1 binds 6dd3b1d2... while the current committed evaluator is 018149dd...; the only source changes are progress_sink instrumentation.
findings.reasoning: Direct equality correctly fails closed, but there is no explicit compatibility proof through which scientifically identical instrumentation drift can be accepted.
findings.suggestion: Add and independently validate a hash-bound type-A evaluator compatibility manifest; never alias either hash or rewrite the P1 receipt.

findings.evidence_locator: The function requires control/budgets/p2-r1-primary-v1.yaml while source-of-truth selects p2-r1-primary-v2.
findings.observation: An active v2 request cannot satisfy the hard-coded v1 campaign binding.
findings.reasoning: Using v1 as fallback would mix campaign revisions and invalidate lineage.
findings.suggestion: Resolve the profile, envelope, revision, and compatibility authority from source-of-truth and fail closed on absence or disagreement.

findings.evidence_locator: The registry contains myis.p2-request.v1 but not myis.p2-measured-request.v1; measured_contracts.py maintains a separate registry.
findings.observation: The active request cannot traverse the shared preflight/report validation path.
findings.reasoning: Duplicated registries create inconsistent lifecycle counting and schema authority.
findings.suggestion: Register measured requests in the shared registry and dispatch lazily to one measured semantic validator to avoid circular imports.
